reference: AutoHex TD existing low-poly tower material and silhouette vocabulary, from provided game screenshots and local assets. The seven sheets are new concept art.

prompts.prompt:
Create a polished game-art CONCEPT SHEET, landscape 1792x1024, for AutoHex TD. This is a visual upgrade tree for ONE tower family. Match an existing low-poly isometric medieval hex tower-defense game: very compact round grey stone tower bases, a few broad faceted stone blocks, weathered brass, dark wood, simple polygon shapes, restrained magical glow. Game-sized objects, not gigantic fantasy cathedrals. Orthographic camera 35 degrees from above, consistent scale and ground-plane, soft neutral studio shadows. Warm off-white parchment background, charcoal labels in clean Barlow-like sans, tiny gold dividers. NO UI chrome, no logos, no UI cards, no interface simulation. Strong silhouettes are more important than tiny ornament. Each model isolated with generous whitespace.

LAYOUT must show exactly SEVEN tower models. Four columns. LEFT column one shared base tower, centered vertically. Upper row columns 2,3,4 show path A stages 2,3,4. Lower row columns 2,3,4 show path B stages 2,3,4. Thin clean branching arrows from base to the two rows and left to right along each path. Across top large title, then column headings exactly "STUFE 1", "STUFE 2", "STUFE 3", "ULTIMATE". Place each model name immediately below its model. Do not repeat the base model. All seven models MUST look distinct and visually grow in mechanical sophistication while retaining the family silhouette. Ultimates about 1.35x base height maximum. The final two models are BOTH essential and fully visible. In a slim bottom strip, show one small gameplay effect vignette and the label "ANGRIFF". Very little text, no numeric statistics.

Title exactly "Gravitationsturm". Family motif: a small BLACK SPHERE suspended above a squat grey stone pedestal in three brass claws, thin violet accretion ring, heavy brass orbital frames, readable in top-down game.
Base label "Gravitationsturm", render the simplest form.
UPPER branch left-to-right: "Verdichter" = two sturdy bronze crescent arms drawing toward a black orb; "Singularitätskern" = three concentric heavy brass orbit rings and a larger dark sphere; "Ereignishorizont" = broad horizontal golden accretion disk around an unmistakable pitch black hole in a four-claw cage.
LOWER branch left-to-right: "Resonator" = a taller forked plinth with paired small violet lenses; "Gezeitenlinse" = three angular prongs surrounding two small orbiting dark cores; "Pulsar" = a tall three-pronged resonator surrounding a dark core, two thin violet pulse rings radiating outward.
Gameplay effect vignette: a small black hole over a dirt road drawing five little faceted enemy silhouettes inward with short curved arrows. Keep their feet on the road.
Final check: exactly seven different models, both ultimate designs, all stage labels legible, no cropped models, consistent isometric view, suitable for simple low-poly 3D reconstruction.
